source: Make me a game where myself and other players attend classes at a magic academy. We all get chosen for one of three houses (come up with names, color schemes and insignias/emblems for them yourself). For now I want the basis of the game to allow me to explore different classes on my schedule and have activities within them like learning how to make potions or fly on a broom. I earn money to purchase upgrades for my room or to get more eggs for a new partner animal

image_prompt.text: Classroom buildings, dormitories, and shops on the campus that players go inside
A central campus square where students gather and where the shops selling room upgrades and creature eggs sit
Walkways linking the square to the classroom buildings and the three house quarters
Three physically separate house quarters, each with its own architecture and colour scheme, distinct from the shared academic core
an open-air ground beside the campus for broom flight practice
house banners and emblems displayed over each quarter

layout_placement.text: Class activity stations - a potion bench, a broom launch point - that run the lesson when a scheduled student steps into them

notes: Pet Care preset taken whole: claimable rooms rather than built plots, since the player upgrades a room they are given.
Simulation loaded as a secondary for trigger-task only; Roleplay cannot express a class activity station. social-hub deduped to the Roleplay wording.
settlement-claimable and building-interior both force P3; interiors are generated separately.

open_questions.ask: How large should the campus be - a few buildings around one courtyard, or a sprawling grounds?
Are classes scheduled events all players attend together, or can you walk into one any time?
Is the room you upgrade inside your house quarter, or somewhere separate?

coverage_missing.ask: How large should the campus be?
Are classes scheduled events, or enterable any time?
Is the upgradeable room inside your house quarter?

answers.ask: How large should the campus be - a few buildings around one courtyard, or a sprawling grounds?
answers.answer: Use a compact campus with a few key buildings around one central courtyard, so the first version is easy to explore and plainly playable.

answers.ask: Are classes scheduled events all players attend together, or can you walk into one any time?
answers.answer: Classes should follow each player's schedule, with players able to walk into their scheduled class when it is active rather than requiring everyone to attend together.

answers.ask: Is the room you upgrade inside your house quarter, or somewhere separate?
answers.answer: The upgradeable room is the player's dorm room inside their assigned house quarter.
